name: Danlaw Technologies India Limited
about: Danlaw Technologies India Limited provides engineering and software development consulting services and industrial electronics internationally. The company provides telematics products, including telematics Control Unit- 2G, an IP67 ingress-protected device that collects CAN data from ECU's in vehicles; and telematics Control Unit- 4G, a 4G tracking device. The company also offers DataLogger, an IoT gadget that securely collects and transmits vehicle and sensor data to the platform through cellular or bluetooth connection; body control unit for monitoring and controlling various electronic accessories in a vehicle body; diagnostic tool, an advanced PC application used to v and flashing through USB interface and supports monitoring of live data from the ECU; and electronics manufacturing services; as well as sells scrap. Danlaw Technologies India Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.
